vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: Cherio was born from a simple vision: creating an ecosystem of applications that facilitate creation, commerce, and innovation. We believe in the power of technology to transform ideas into reality, and we build tools that enable everyone to bring their projects to life, whether it's selling products, creating digital content, or developing innovative technical solutions.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: We develop cutting-edge technology solutions, integrating artificial intelligence and the latest advances to provide you with an optimal experience.

simplicity.title: Simplicity
simplicity.description: Our applications are designed to be intuitive and easy to use, without compromising on power and functionality.

ecosystem.title: Unified ecosystem
ecosystem.description: All our applications work together harmoniously, sharing a common infrastructure and integrated services.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: We are committed to providing high-quality products, carefully designed and tested to ensure the best user experience.

about.title: About Cherio
about.content: Cherio is a modern application ecosystem designed to meet the diverse needs of creators, entrepreneurs, and developers. From the online store to the creative tools suite, through technical services and the project portfolio, Cherio offers a complete range of integrated solutions. Our mission is to simplify creation, commerce, and innovation by providing powerful, accessible, and elegant tools.

beWel.metaDescription: Calculate a co-owner's exact share of Be-Well residence expenses based on the 13 official distribution keys in the co-ownership bylaws.
beWel.title: Co-ownership & Tantièmes Calculator
beWel.subtitle: Estimate a co-owner's exact share across one or more residence expenses in real time, using the 13 official distribution keys.
beWel.stepLotsSubtitle: Select one or more units (e.g. apartment + parking), or enter your tantièmes manually.

beWel.manualTantiemesLabel: Tantièmes held for the applied key
beWel.manualTantiemesHint: In manual mode, this tantièmes value is applied to each expense row (useful for a quick single-key check).
beWel.stepExpensesSubtitle: Add one or more expense items with their official distribution key.
beWel.heatingThirtyLabel: Calculate only the 30% fixed share split by tantièmes
beWel.heatingThirtyHint: The bylaws split heating 30% by tantièmes (key 11) and 70% by individual meter readings.
beWel.emptySummaryHint: Select at least one unit (or enter your tantièmes) and enter an amount to see the detailed breakdown.
beWel.referenceToggle: View the 13 official keys & bylaw rules
beWel.legalNoteBody: Formula: Amount × (Your tantièmes / Key base). The bylaws also provide for individual metering on cold water, heating (30% fixed / 70% metered), and domestic hot water (DHW). The 'unit share' key used by the property manager on the extranet has no legal standing in the bylaws.
